items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: I will get the money and I will give it to Lester's son and his wife.

ctx.x: You see everybody has something out on him now, and his family gets nothing. Because they don't understand, and they do this in the record business all the time. They don't get an accounting for the music they've written, they don't get accounting for the performances -- so they can tell Mary or Lester, 'Oh, I paid him when he did this. There was no royalty deal.'

But there's no such thing as no royalty deal. Now that I'm in the record business, I know that when a person performs and if they are the artist, there is a royalty deal someplace. So if you don't have one now, you can make one. And that's really the way I feel about it, because I'm going to take the same songs, the same arrangements, and I'm going to copyright them and I'm gonna put them in my publishing company, which is called Flipside, when you see Flipside, you'll know -- that I will get the money and I will…
But I'll make them come after it. Because I know how to fight them about it. But see, they don't have a clue. You got to fight them about it.
